title: SCP-294 game
author: MeroveeFrancSalien
selftext:
Hello,

I am in the very early stages of developing a game based on SCP-294.

The game runs using a local AI, Qwen, which is automatically installed in the game folder the first time you launch it.

SCP-294 is an anomalous coffee machine equipped with a keypad that can dispense any liquid in existence—and that’s where the AI ​​comes in.

There is no pre-established database of liquids within the game; the AI ​​handles that instead.

The game is being developed using Claude (Sonnet 3.5, via the "Max" setting, without a paid subscription).

It’s still very early, but here is a short video to showcase it.

I’m already aware of what needs to be fixed for future versions.

It’s pure "vibe-coding"—I’m letting Claude take care of everything.

Thank !

comments.author: MeroveeFrancSalien
comments.body: The issue I am currently fixing is that the request process takes a very long time, so I am addressing that.

comments.author: MeroveeFrancSalien
comments.body: I’ll also add the option to use paid AIs in-game via an API key, that way, those who want to play for free can do so, while those who prefer to use a more advanced AI have that option as well.

comments.author: thecrownforge
comments.body: The long wait may be the main thing to test first. Could the machine start its animation right away, while the liquid is generated? For repeat requests, you could cache the result. That keeps the surprise without making players stare at a loading screen.

replies.author: MeroveeFrancSalien
replies.body: Actually, that’s exactly what Claude told me, he’s in the process of fixing the issue for the next version.

comments.author: MeroveeFrancSalien
comments.body: And for those wondering what SCP-294 is, here is the link: [https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-294](https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-294)

comments.author: krazyjakee
comments.body:
My absolute favorite SCP. Nice job!

Why do you need an AI model in the game itself? Why not an algorithm or rules engine?

replies.author: MeroveeFrancSalien
replies.body: Because I really want to see if an AI can handle an SCP like SCP-294, given its somewhat unpredictability—and also to see if the AI ​​can actually make things interesting. I think using AI is pretty cool, especially since I’m going to include an option to choose which AI to use in the next version, for those who want it.

replies.author: krazyjakee
replies.body: It is very cool. A trained micro decision model might be perfect for production and require very little hardware to deliver unpredictable and interesting results.

replies.author: MeroveeFrancSalien
replies.body: The thing is, there also needs to be some logic and consistency in what the AI ​​does, I don’t want it to serve me something unpredictable when I’ve asked for water.
